script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A dimly lit living room. SAM, late 30s, sits on an old armchair. He holds a tattered newspaper in his hands, his eyes focused on a particular article. His wife, MAYA, early 30s, enters the room carrying a tray of coffee.

MAYA
(softly)
What's got you so engrossed, love?

Sam looks up, his face a mixture of sadness and determination.

SAM
(serious)
The city has announced a new initiative. They're looking for designers to build a public park.

Maya sets down the tray on the coffee table and sits next to him.

MAYA
(smiling)
And you're planning to apply?

SAM
(nodding)
I have to try, Maya. This could be my chance.

Maya takes Sam's hand.

MAYA
I believe in you, Sam.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

Sam, surrounded by sketches and blueprints, works tirelessly in his small studio. Hours pass as he experiments with different designs. He makes several calls to potential investors and city officials.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Maya sits on the armchair, her eyes heavy with worry. Sam enters the room, exhausted but determined.

SAM
(exhausted)
I've made some progress. A few investors have shown interest.

Maya gets up and hugs Sam.

MAYA
I'm so proud of you, Sam.

INT. CITY HALL - DAY

Sam presents his park design to the city council. He speaks passionately about his vision of a green space in the heart of the city. The council members are impressed, and the room erupts into applause.

INT. STUDIO - NIGHT

With the help of investors and the city, Sam begins constructing the park. He works late into the night, surrounded by the sounds of construction.

INT. PUBLIC PARK - DAY

The park, now in its final stages, is bustling with activity. Families picnic, children play, and people take leisurely walks. Sam stands in the middle, taking it all in, his face filled with satisfaction.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Maya and Sam sit in their living room, surrounded by photos of the park and articles about its success.

MAYA
(smiling)
I'm so glad you followed your dream, Sam.

SAM
(smiling back)
And I'm glad I had you by my side.

They share a loving embrace, their faces filled with happiness and contentment.

FADE OUT.

---

That's a modern drama screenplay without guns, violence, copyrighted characters, or weapons combat. I hope you find it interesting and engaging. Let me know if you need any revisions or additions.

Best,
Your professional screenwriter.
